campos.descripcion: nRFLR2021 LoRa Module–nRF52840 & LR2021 for Multi-Band IoT Connectivity The nRFLR2021 is a high-performance multi-protocol LoRa module that combines the Nordic nRF52840 MCU with Semtech’s fourth-generation LR2021 LoRa transceiver . It supports Sub-GHz, 2.4 GHz ISM, and licensed S-band connectivity for flexible terrestrial and satellite IoT applications . The module supports LoRaWAN 1.0.4 Class A, B, and C , as well as Amazon Sidewalk, Sigfox, Wi-SUN FSK, W-MBUS, and Z-Wave , while the nRF52840 adds Bluetooth LE, BLE Mesh , NFC, Thread, and Zigbee connectivity. With FLRC speeds up to 2.6 Mbps , built-in AT commands, SDK support, UART connectivity , and low-power operation, the nRFLR2021 is ideal for global IoT, remote sensing, asset tracking, industrial applications, and emergency communication. Feature LoRa Transceiver : Semtech fourth-generation LR2021 with Sub-GHz, 2.4 GHz ISM, and licensed S-band support Multi-Protocol Support : LoRaWAN 1.0.4 Class A/B/C, Amazon Sidewalk, Sigfox, Wi-SUN FSK, W-MBUS, and Z-Wave Wireless Connectivity: nRF52840 with Bluetooth LE, BLE Mesh, NFC, Thread, and Zigbee High-Speed Communication: FLRC modulation with data rates up to 2.6 Mbps LoRa Modulation: Supports LoRa, (G)FSK, LR-FHSS, and FLRC modulation Frequency Range: Sub-GHz 150–960 MHz, 2.4 GHz ISM, and licensed S-band 1900–2200 MHz Long-Range Connectivity: Typical communication range of 5–8 km, with over 12 km possible under line-of-sight conditions Low Power: Chip-level sleep current as low as 470 nA and Sub-GHz receive current of 5.7 mA Easy Development: Built-in AT command firmware, SDK support, and UART interface for quick integration Industrial Grade: Operating temperature from -40°C to +85°C Certifications: FCC ID and CE (RED) Specification Processor nRF52840 processor, dual-core 32-bit, 64MHz main frequency, RF chip Semtech LR2021 Chip LoRa Specification Transmit P ower TX 22 dBm@Max(SUB-GHz), 12dBm(2.4 GHz) Receiving S ensitivity -141.5dBm @SF12/BW=125kHz Link Budget Demodulator Support LoRa/(G)FSK signal modulation ，SF5~SF1 2 ;
